description: Shadow and fire, spent all at once - the fastest damage a warlock can throw.

nodes.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
nodes.description: Your Shadow Bolt crits leave the target taking 4% more damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built close to verbatim: 'Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage dealt to the target by 4%-20%.' KEPT AS A PROC because the real text is trigger-shaped. The chance IS scaled by points by the engine (capped 100, only when max_points > 1) while the PAYLOAD IS NOT, which is this project's multi-rank proc idiom - so five ranks buy reliability rather than size. There is no shadow-specific damage-TAKEN key, so it is bare damage_taken_pct, which is read RAW ON BOTH SIDES (0.04 is 4%) and is one of only eight stat_mods A MONSTER CAN READ.

nodes.name: Bane
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Chaos Bolt by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Chaos Bolt and Immolate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.' DEPARTURE - THERE ARE NO CAST TIMES in this engine, so the talent has no content to port. Faster casting is more damage per fight, so it becomes damage on exactly the three spells the real talent names (Soul Fire does not exist). This is the first of three cast-time talents in this tree, and all three are retargeted rather than dropped.

nodes.name: Aftermath
nodes.description: Increases the periodic damage of your Immolate by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the periodic damage done by your Immolate by 3%/6%, and your Conflagrate has a 100% chance to daze the target for 5 sec.' The Immolate half is VERBATIM. The daze is unbuildable - there is no movement speed, and no snare or root system of any kind - and a daze is not a stun, so is_stun would be the wrong substitute rather than a near one. Rank text read from the reference before authoring; the name alone would not have revealed either half.

nodes.name: Molten Skin
nodes.description: Reduces physical damage taken by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Reduces all physical damage taken by 2%/4%/6%.' physical_damage_taken_pct is A FRACTION AS A TALENT EFFECT and POINTS inside a status effect - the same key, two conventions, and audit_talents is the only thing that catches the wrong one. It is read via the f-string f'{damage_type}_damage_taken_pct' at monster.py:743 and character.py:2781, so grep cannot see the read site and the key is nonetheless LIVE.

nodes.name: Cataclysm
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your direct damage spells by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim for the spells that exist: 'Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 4%/7%/10%.' _cost_pct is A FRACTION and POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION, which is the opposite sign to every other _pct key in this file.

nodes.name: Demonic Power
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain by 6 sec and reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt by 0.5 sec.' Individual PET ABILITIES are not addressable and there are no cast times, so it becomes pet_damage - one of only THREE live pet keys (pet_damage, pet_health, pet_armor; pet.py:139-146). pet_crit and pet_haste are DEAD, measured on a live pet.

nodes.name: Shadowburn
nodes.description: Teaches Shadowburn, a soul spent for an instant kill.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_shadowburn, which is requires_talent. At its real row.

nodes.name: Ruin
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your spells by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built close to verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 20%-100%.' Scaled down hard: the real 100% assumes an 80-level raid environment, and Frontier fights run 2-3 turns on trash and 5-6 on a boss, so a doubled crit bonus would make a single lucky Shadow Bolt the whole encounter. crit_damage_spell IS LIVE - it is read at abilities.py:1460 INSIDE A TERNARY, which is why a literal read-site probe reports nothing for it and why it was nearly declared dead.

nodes.name: Intensity
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Immolate and Searing Pain by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting or channeling any Destruction spell by 70%.' DEPARTURE - there are no cast times and therefore NO PUSHBACK to reduce. Being able to keep channelling becomes being able to afford it, which is the SAME PRECEDENT used for Fel Concentration in warlock_affliction - the two pushback talents in this class are translated the same way deliberately, so the pattern is legible rather than ad-hoc. Second of three cast-time talents.

nodes.name: Destructive Reach
nodes.description: Reduces the threat your spells generate by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built for the half that works: 'Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 10%/20% and reduces threat caused by 5%/10%.' THERE IS NO RANGE OR POSITIONING in this engine at all, so only the threat half survives, at the doubled rate to keep the node worth two points. threat_multiplier is TALENT-CHANNEL ONLY - it would be SILENT DEAD DATA inside a proc's stat_mods, which is the single most common bug class in this project.

nodes.name: Improved Searing Pain
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 4%/7%/10%.' ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS while ability_<id>_crit_damage next door is a FRACTION - and a greedy regex in probe_talent_key.py once mis-split this very key family, falsely accusing all 20 legitimate _crit_damage keys in the project.

nodes.name: Backlash
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 1% per rank, and being struck has a 8% chance to empower your next spells.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, both halves built: 'Increases your critical strike chance with spells by 1%-3% and gives you a 8%-25% chance when hit by a physical attack to reduce the cast time of your next Shadow Bolt or Incinerate by 100%.' The crit half is verbatim. The instant-cast half becomes damage, since there are no cast times - but THE TRIGGER IS REAL and is kept, which is what makes this a proc rather than another flat node. crit_chance_spell is POINTS as a talent effect; the proc's damage_dealt_pct is POINTS TOO but is the ONLY damage key a status effect can carry (abilities.py:1680) - spell_damage there would be silently dead.

nodes.name: Improved Immolate
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Immolate by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built verbatim: 'Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 5%/10%/15%.' Stacks with Aftermath and Bane, as all three real talents do.

nodes.name: Devastation
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 5%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.' A 1-point node for 5 points of crit is the real tree's own shape and is the natural prerequisite for Emberstorm above it. crit_chance_spell is PERCENTAGE POINTS - note hit_chance_spell, by contrast, IS DEAD as a talent key.

nodes.name: Nether Protection
nodes.description: Being hit by a spell has a 10% chance per rank to reduce spell damage taken by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built close to verbatim: 'After being hit with a spell, you have a 10%-30% chance to gain Nether Protection, reducing all damage by that spell school by 30% for 8 sec.' DEPARTURE on ONE clause: it cannot be school-specific, because proc['school'] only TYPES a damage_flat payload and is NOT a trigger-side filter, and there is no on-hit-by-school trigger. So it reduces spell damage generally, at 20% rather than 30% to pay for being broader. CRITICAL: spell_damage_taken_pct is POINTS INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT (hence -20.0) and a FRACTION as a talent effect - Molten Skin two tiers down uses the fraction form of its sibling key. 8 sec is 2 turns.

nodes.name: Emberstorm
nodes.description: Increases your Fire spell damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2%-10%.' USES THE PER-SCHOOL KEY DELIBERATELY: fire_spell_damage is built as f'{school}_spell_damage' at abilities.py:1371, which walks EVERY COMPONENT of a school list, so a literal grep cannot see it. This is the family that caused arcane_spell_damage to be WRONGLY DECLARED DEAD earlier in this project. It is LIVE and is the correct key for a school-scoped talent.

nodes.name: Conflagrate
nodes.description: Teaches Conflagrate, consuming your Immolate for a burst of fire.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_conflagrate, which is requires_talent. At its real row; the outgoing tree had it two tiers lower.

nodes.name: Soul Leech
nodes.description: Your direct damage spells have a 10% chance per rank to heal you for 20% of the damage.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6, built close to verbatim: 'Gives your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Soul Fire, Incinerate, Conflagrate, Chaos Bolt and Searing Pain spells a 10%-30% chance to return health equal to 20% of the damage caused.' The chance, the 20% return and the ability list (for the spells that exist) are all real. leech_pct is one of only THREE payloads that read the triggering hit's amount, so this genuinely scales off damage dealt. ability_filter is validated by the kit against the real ability list, which is what catches a typo here instead of it silently never firing.

nodes.name: Pyroclasm
nodes.description: Your Conflagrate and Searing Pain crits raise your damage by 2% per rank for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6, built close to verbatim: 'Your Conflagrate, Searing Pain and Soul Fire spells have a 100% chance to increase the damage you deal with all spells by 2%-6% for 10 sec.' Soul Fire does not exist. CHANCE IS 34, NOT THE REAL 100%, and that is a deliberate correction: a proc's PAYLOAD cannot scale with points, only its CHANCE can, so a 3-rank node at 100% would make ranks 2 and 3 BUY LITERALLY NOTHING. The first draft of this file did exactly that and wrote a source note defending it; check_talent_balance.py caught all four such nodes across the three Warlock trees. 34 x 3 = 102, clamped to 100, so full rank reaches the real certainty while each point buys a third of it. An icd of 1 stops a crit streak stacking it. 10 sec is 3 turns, inside the measured window.

nodes.name: Shadow and Flame
nodes.description: Your Shadow Bolt has a 8% chance per rank to grant 60 spell power for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 7, built close to verbatim: 'Your Shadow Bolt and Incinerate spells have a 20%-100% chance to increase spell power by 180 for 10 sec.' Incinerate does not exist. The chance is rank-scaled (8 x 5 = 40% at full rank, well under the real 100% because 180 spell power is an 80-level raid number and 60 is sized for 60). spell_power is FLAT in a status effect, and it IS status-readable - _recalculate_derived_stats folds status effects into the SAME `bonuses` pool as gear and talents (character.py:1218), which is the measurement that cleared ten keys wrongly accused by the first draft of qa_proc_stat_mods.py.

nodes.name: Improved Soul Leech
nodes.description: Your direct damage spells have a 8% chance per rank to restore 80 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 7: 'Your Soul Leech effect also restores mana to you and your summoned demon equal to 2% of maximum mana, and has a 100% chance to grant up to 10 party or raid members mana regeneration.' THREE DEPARTURES, all forced: a NESTED proc inside apply_effect works but nothing can trigger off ANOTHER PROC firing, so this is its own trigger on the same ability list rather than a rider on Soul Leech; demons have NO RESOURCE; and A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY (only a party-targeted ABILITY can, abilities.py:2064), so the raid half is lost. grant_resource takes a FLAT amount - there is no pct_max - so the real 2% cannot be expressed and 80 is sized against a level-60 warlock's pool. Warlock resource confirmed MANA before authoring, per the standing check-the-resource-first rule.

nodes.name: Backdraft
nodes.description: Your Conflagrate quickens your casting by 10% per rank for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8: 'When you cast Conflagrate, the cast time and global cooldown of your next three Destruction spells is reduced by 10%-30%.' DEPARTURE - no cast times and no global cooldown, and NOTHING COUNTS 'your next three spells' either (there is no cast counter, streak or accumulator of any kind in this engine). Delivered as haste on a timer instead, which is the nearest thing the engine has to casting faster. Third and last of the three cast-time talents. CHANCE IS 34, NOT THE REAL 100%, for the same reason as Pyroclasm above: only a proc's chance scales with points, so a 3-rank node at 100% gives ranks 2 and 3 nothing at all. 34 x 3 clamps to 100 at full rank.

nodes.name: Shadowfury
nodes.description: Teaches Shadowfury, slamming the ground to stun everything near.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_shadowfury, which is requires_talent. At its real row.

nodes.name: Empowered Imp
nodes.description: Increases your demon's damage by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8: 'Increases the damage done by your Imp by 10%-30%, and all critical hits done by your Imp have a 100% chance to increase your spell critical hit chance for your next spell by 100%.' The damage half is VERBATIM. The crit feedback half is unbuildable at the root: PETS NEVER FIRE PROCS - there is no fire_proc_trigger anywhere in entities/pet.py - and there is no guaranteed-crit key either, so both halves of that clause are blocked.

nodes.name: Fire and Brimstone
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Chaos Bolt and Conflagrate by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 9: 'Increases the damage of your Incinerate and Chaos Bolt on targets afflicted by your Immolate by 2%-10%, and the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate by 2%-10%.' DEPARTURE - NOTHING READS A DEBUFF ON THE TARGET, which is one of the hardest confirmed engine limits and the same gap that blocks conditional talents in four other classes. The Immolate condition is therefore dropped and the bonus is unconditional, at 3% per rank rather than the real 2% because it no longer has a setup cost. Conflagrate takes damage rather than crit so the node reads as one effect.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolt
nodes.description: Teaches Chaos Bolt, a bolt that cannot be resisted.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for warlock_chaos_bolt, which is requires_talent. At its real row.
